title: ERP or business API by OpenAPI (read-only)

pin.name: Rihmasto's narrow read-only OpenAPI server, in this folder, reading this folder's openapi.json

notes: One connector for any system an OpenAPI document describes: SAP (OData services publish OpenAPI), Dynamics 365, NetSuite REST, or a generic business API. Copy the folder per system (connectors/<system>/), replace openapi.json with that system's document, and give the base URL and the token by reference.
